on Wednesday announced the appointment of Michael Steib as CEO, succeeding Jeff Kip.
As CEO, Steib will remain a member of Angi’s board and lead Angi’s executive team, overseeing strategy and daily management of the company.
As Steib assumes the CEO role, Joey Levin will transition from his role as executive chairman of the Board to chairman. All changes are effective immediately.
